finding.status: closed by unchanged independent reproduction on repair
finding.repairAssessment: Original recognition now rejects eligibility documents with the original/current invoice hash. Adjustment now derives invoice hashes from the validated immutable original approval tax facts and rejects those bytes even when separately stored under another kind/name/source.

limits: Synthetic documents and humans in isolated convex-test; no real tax policy or practitioner sign-off.
No UI, QBO tax export, live backend, provider or credential validation.
Single-winner concurrency exercises convex-test transaction semantics; not a load test.
